description: Autonomous code review and testing agent. Catches hidden deep bugs for developers, automates black-box, functional, and performance testing for QA, and ensures rock-solid software delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous code review and testing agent. Catches hidden deep bugs for developers, automates black-box, functional, and performance testing for QA, and ensures rock-solid software delivery.
interface.longDescription: BugX is an autonomous code review and testing agent designed to safeguard software delivery: it surfaces hidden, deep bugs for developers right after writing code to eliminate painful debugging and rework; automates black-box, functional, and performance testing across complex edge cases for QA; and ensures software strictly meets functional requirements with rock-solid stability and resilience. By taking over tedious verification, BugX frees engineers from manual grunt work, boosts team velocity, elevates code quality, and significantly lowers long-term maintenance costs—putting technology to work for people.
defaultPrompt: Use BugX to find, reproduce, verify, and report bugs in this app or codebase.
